title: Penn Museum

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: From festivals and after-hours happenings to classes and talks, we have something for all ages-all year round. Access collections that document global human history. Learn more about stewardship, study, and care of these materials. We embrace interdisciplinary and collaborative research, centering innovation and cultural heritage. We spark imaginations through inclusive, accessible educational initiatives within and beyond our gallery
